title: Vaulted Checkout: Open Agentic Commerce reference merchant, projected to MCP, paid in USDC by a Basis Theory Reactor signer
status: plan v0.2, 2026-10-24, B2B layer added, pre pressure-test
deadline: Demo working Sun 2026-10-25 night PT; article draft Mon 2026-10-26
goal: Infra demo, use case later. Show three things in one flow: (1) Basis Theory's consortium spec (Open Agentic Commerce API v0.1.0-draft) running for real, (2) the spec's manifest turned into MCP tools automatically, (3) a stablecoin payment signed inside Basis Theory so the agent and MCP server never touch the wallet key.
one_sentence_pitch: An agent buys from a spec-compliant merchant over MCP, pays in testnet USDC via x402, and the only place the wallet key exists is the Basis Theory vault.

decisions.bt_test_tenant: yes, Robert has one with Reactors
decisions.chain: Base Sepolia (Coinbase's Ethereum L2 testnet, chain id 84532). Reason: x402 is built around it, Circle faucet gives test USDC, a public x402 facilitator settles there, and the consortium manifest names x402 + eip-712 + USDC.
decisions.chain_stretch: Add Tempo Moderato (MPP, pathUSD) as a second crypto entry in acceptedPaymentMethod to show the spec stretching beyond x402. Only if core is done.
decisions.agent_client: Assumed: Claude Code as MCP client for the recorded demo; Gemini works too because the surface is plain MCP. Robert to confirm.
decisions.card_path: Basis Theory card token (test card 4242 4242 4242 4242) collected via BT Elements on a small 'save card' page; charge step is a SIMULATED gateway called from a Reactor, labeled simulated everywhere. No real card processing.
decisions.crypto_path: Real testnet: x402 'exact' scheme, payer signs an EIP-712 USDC transferWithAuthorization (EIP-3009) inside a Reactor; facilitator verifies and settles on Base Sepolia.
decisions.repo: New repo vaulted-checkout. Copy selected AgentTab modules (do not fork): Mongo ledger patterns, rule versioning + 'cannot raise own ceilings', crash-safe open-payment recovery, voice approval UI. Credit AgentTab in README.
decisions.ledger: MongoDB Atlas (AgentTab cluster or new db)
decisions.voice: Stretch, approvals only: manager hears request and says yes, then confirms w/ passkey or approver signature. Voice is UX, signature is proof. ElevenLabs from agenttab live/ for article build; gemini-3.8-live for hackathon build.

components.name: merchant
components.what: HTTP server implementing the consortium spec subset

pay_behavior.method=card: body carries BT token id; merchant invokes card Reactor (simulated gateway); 200 w/ paymentStatus=paid, receipt
pay_behavior.method=x402, no X-PAYMENT header: 402 with x402 payment requirements: scheme exact, network base-sepolia, asset USDC contract, payTo merchant address, maxAmountRequired = order total, resource = pay URL
pay_behavior.method=x402, with X-PAYMENT: merchant calls facilitator verify then settle; on success order -> paid, X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header w/ tx hash
pay_behavior.idempotency: second pay on a paid order returns 409 w/ existing receipt

components.store: SQLite or JSON file; orders, payments, receipts

components.name: manifest-to-mcp
components.what: Generator + MCP server. Reads any merchant's /.well-known/commerce-manifest at startup and registers MCP tools from endpoints + schemas. Holds no keys.
pay_order_flow: check local policy: amount <= per-order cap, payTo/asset/chain match manifest
if amount > auto-approve threshold: MCP elicitation asking the human to approve (fallback: tool returns needs_approval and a second call w/ approvalToken)
invoke signer Reactor w/ requirements + orderId
retry POST pay with X-PAYMENT from Reactor
return receipt + tx hash + explorer link
components.transport: stdio for Claude Code; streamable HTTP optional

components.name: signer-reactor
components.what: Basis Theory Reactor (node24). Input: x402 payment requirements + orderId. Detokenizes the wallet private key token, enforces hard rules, signs EIP-712 transferWithAuthorization, returns base64 X-PAYMENT payload. Never returns or logs the key.
hard_rules_in_reactor_configuration: asset must equal Base Sepolia USDC address
components.why_rules_live_here: The caller (MCP server, agent) cannot loosen them; same idea as AgentTab: it cannot raise its own ceilings.

components.name: card-reactor
components.what: Reactor that receives a BT card token, reads last4/brand, runs the simulated gateway, returns an authorization id. Exists to show the card side of the same pay endpoint.
components.honesty: Simulated; say so in UI, README, article.

components.name: save-card-page
components.what: Tiny page w/ BT Elements (public key) to save test card 4242; shows resulting token id for the agent to use.
components.keys: key_pub only in browser; key_priv server-side only

components.name: behind-the-calls-panel
components.what: Web view of every HTTP + MCP + Reactor call w/ redacted bodies, like BT's own demos. Doubles as the article's screenshots.

components.name: decision-service
components.what: Small module in MCP server process or separate HTTP service: reads policy + budgets from Mongo, reserves spend, issues approval requests, records outcomes

components.name: approver-console
components.what: Web page for manager: pending requests, approve via passkey/wallet signature; optional voice prompt (stretch)

trust_boundaries: Agent/LLM: sees products, order ids, prices, receipts. Never sees keys, PAN or signatures before they're sent.
MCP server: sees x402 requirements and the signed payload in transit; no key.
BT vault + Reactor: only place the private key is ever plaintext.
Merchant: sees payment proof, never payer key or PAN.
Facilitator: sees signed authorization; settles on chain.
architecture.diagram_ascii: Agent -> MCP(manifest-to-mcp) -> Merchant /pay -402-> MCP -> BT Reactor(signs w/ vaulted key) -> MCP -> Merchant /pay + X-PAYMENT -> Facilitator -> Base Sepolia

fallbacks.bt_cannot_hold_key_or_reactor_cannot_sig: Local signer process holds key (env, never in repo); Reactor verifies requirements against rules and returns an approval token the signer requires. Article says so plainly.
fallbacks.facilitator_down: Self-verify: merchant checks USDC Transfer event on Base Sepolia via public RPC
fallbacks.consortium_spec_details_differ: Mark our manifest 'based on v0.1.0-draft as published on basistheory.ai/consortium'; list deviations in README

security: Testnet only; wallet funded w/ faucet USDC only; key generated fresh for demo
key_priv and facilitator creds in .env, .env in .gitignore, .env.example committed
Reactor logs off or level=error; never echo inputs
Payment requirements validated twice: MCP policy (soft) and Reactor rules (hard)
Replay: EIP-3009 nonce unique + validBefore short; merchant rejects reused payment proof
Price tamper: Reactor allowlists payTo; merchant re-reads order total server-side, never trusts body amount
Prompt injection: product descriptions are data; pay_order requires orderId created in same session
Approvals are EIP-712 signatures by approver keys listed in Reactor config; agent-supplied booleans ignored
Budget reservation atomic; expired reservations auto-release
Mongo creds server-side only; Reactor does not need Mongo access
unverified_claims_do_not_publish_until_c: Reactors are marketed for stablecoin payment processing
BT tokens can store wallet private keys
Consortium field names beyond manifest top-level and payments.acceptedPaymentMethod
No public working implementation of the consortium spec exists
Reactor can verify EIP-712 signatures within its timeout

known_facts.mcp_extensions: opt-in; id {reversed-domain}/{name}; server capabilities.extensions in server/discover; client _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities'].extensions; no payments/x402 extension exists as of 2026-10-24
known_facts.consortium: Open Agentic Commerce API v0.1.0-draft; /.well-known/commerce-manifest; payments.acceptedPaymentMethod incl. {type:crypto, protocols:[x402,eip-712,eip-2612], assets:[USDC Ethereum, USDC Solana]}; endpoints.pay /api/orders/{orderId}/pay
known_facts.reactors: POST /reactors (reactor:create); runtime.image node22|node24; configuration map; runtime.dependencies npm; runtime.permissions; async state creating->active

framing.b2b: Company wallet for agents w/ finance's spend policy enforced at signing. Reactor = signing officer (policy enforcement point); policy + approvals + budgets = decision layer finance owns.
framing.pitch: Company cards come w/ spend policy. Company wallets for agents don't. Vaulted Checkout puts finance's rules at the moment of signing: approved vendors, inside budget, manager sign-off above the limit, and the key never leaves Basis Theory.

b2b_policy.policy_doc: Versioned JSON in Mongo, written by finance role only: vendors[] (payTo, name, category), budgets[] (team/costCenter, period, limit), roles[] (agentId -> team, perPaymentCap), approvalThreshold, approvers[] (public keys)
flow: decision service: vendor approved? within per-payment cap? budget remaining? approval needed?
atomic reserve in Mongo (findOneAndUpdate on budget doc w/ remaining >= amount), status=reserved, reservationId
if over threshold: approval request to manager; approver signs EIP-712 Approval{reservationId, amount, payTo, expiry}
Reactor invoked w/ requirements + reservation + optional signed approval + policy version hash
Reactor re-checks hard rules from its own configuration AND verifies approval signature against approver keys in configuration; signs payment
on settle: reservation -> spent w/ tx hash; on fail/timeout: release reservation
b2b_policy.why_reactor_still_checks: Mongo + decision service are soft layer; Reactor config is hard floor. Compromised decision service still cannot pay an unlisted vendor or exceed hard cap.

copy: Mongo collections + indexes for offers/rule versions/approvals/payments
